podcast.title: Career as Music Video Director
podcast.body: Dave Myers is a seasoned music video director, described as having been "in the game for a long, long time." He was the featured guest on the debut episode of the "Art Context" podcast, where he discussed his artistic philosophy, body of work, and broader societal issues, including Black Lives Matter, offering his perspective as a white director navigating the black music world. "The first podcast, the debut of the show was with Dave Myers. Another guy that's been in the game for a long, long time, and just talking about the philosophy behind his approach to art. The work he's done, as well digging into some of the larger world issues out there. We have a whole talk about Black Lives Matter on that podcast, and being a white director and his perspective coming up in a black music world."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.body: Director X explained how the "Art Context" podcast transitions from visual storytelling to audio, by focusing on the narrative of the maker. The podcast aims to delve into the philosophy behind their artistic approach and broader world issues, as exemplified by the debut episode's discussion of Black Lives Matter with Dave Meyers. "I mean, the story is the story of the maker. So it's not conceptualizing music and visuals to it. It's talking about the first podcast that debut of the show was with Dave Myers. And as well digging into some of the larger world issues out there, like we have a whole talk about Black Lives Matter on that podcast."

xref.title: Host of "Art Context" Podcast
xref.body: Director X co-hosts a new podcast called "Art Context, the Architects of Art," which focuses on interviewing storytellers from the music video world, exploring their journeys, influences, and the creative process behind iconic content. The debut episode featured an interview with fellow director Dave Meyers. "I have two of the hosts of Art Context with me here. We have Tadges-Krischlo and Director X. We want to give you a bit of an introduction to what this new podcast is all about."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Transition to Audio Storytelling
xref.body: For the "Art Context" podcast, Director X (alongside Taj Krishmal) is transitioning from visual storytelling in music videos to audio storytelling. The podcast focuses on interviews with creators like Dave Meyers, discussing their philosophies, work, and broader issues like Black Lives Matter. "I mean, we're talking to the creators. So it's a different kind of thing. I mean, the story is the story of the maker."
